count.sql:
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wc_posts.ID
					 FROM wc_posts  LEFT JOIN wc_term_relationships ON (wc_posts.ID = wc_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  ( 
    wc_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (2,3,4,5) 
    OR 
    NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT 1
					FROM wc_term_relationships
					INNER JOIN wc_term_taxonomy
					ON wc_term_taxonomy.term_taxonomy_id = wc_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id
					WHERE wc_term_taxonomy.taxonomy = 'product_type'
					AND wc_term_relationships.object_id = wc_posts.ID
				)
  )
) AND wc_posts.post_type IN ('product', 'product_variation') AND ((wc_posts.post_status = 'publish' OR wc_posts.post_status = 'draft' OR wc_posts.post_status = 'pending' OR wc_posts.post_status = 'private'))
					 GROUP BY wc_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wc_posts.ID ASC
					 LIMIT 0, 1

					 FROM wc_posts  LEFT JOIN wc_term_relationships ON (wc_posts.ID = wc_term_relationships.object_id) INNER JOIN wc_postmeta ON ( wc_posts.ID = wc_postmeta.post_id )
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  ( 
    wc_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (2,3,4,5) 
    OR 
    NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT 1
					FROM wc_term_relationships
					INNER JOIN wc_term_taxonomy
					ON wc_term_taxonomy.term_taxonomy_id = wc_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id
					WHERE wc_term_taxonomy.taxonomy = 'product_type'
					AND wc_term_relationships.object_id = wc_posts.ID
